After the CSS-only change, the same input remained focus-visible while the full label exposed a 3px gold outline, 3px offset, and non-empty two-layer shadow in both viewports; the inner input outline was removed to avoid a duplicate ring. Desktop and mobile had no horizontal overflow, the production API base stayed blank, and the console had no warnings/errors. A pointer selection still saved the chosen status, advanced from Question 1 to Question 2 after the existing delay, and focused the next question's first answer. The 26/26 SEO suite locks the card-level focus selector. Cache revision 20260802-quiz-option-focus-ring-1 was synchronized; answers, auto-advance logic/timing, validation, preview, share/referral experiment, tracking, API, checkout, and paid-flow behavior were unchanged. This digest invalidates the evidence on later frontend changes.
